India's Crude Oil Price Surges Amid Global Supply Concerns

India's crude oil import price has reached a five-month high, reportedly hitting $131 per barrel, the highest since March. This surge is attributed to a combination of factors including sanctions on Russia and disruptions to Saudi Arabian oil supplies. Physical oil cargoes have been trading above $130 a barrel, nearing previous record highs due to Saudi disruptions. In response to regional instability, India has condemned a drone attack near Makkah in Saudi Arabia. Global oil prices have seen fluctuations, with some reports indicating a fall due to rising US crude inventories and Saudi Arabia reportedly offering more crude via the Strait of Hormuz.
